aviation_incidents.headline: 漢莎航空波音747-8中止降落避開尾撞 最終延誤不到半小時落地
aviation_incidents.summary: 漢莎航空一架波音747-8在洛杉磯機場降落時，機師中止降落以避開尾撞；飛機最終較表定時間延誤不到半小時落地。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Lufthansa Boeing 747-8 aborts landing to avoid tail strike and lands less than half an hour late
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Pilots of a Lufthansa Boeing 747-8 aborted its landing at Los Angeles International Airport to avoid a tail strike. The aircraft eventually touched down less than half an hour behind schedule.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 華航桃園往返香港航班10月25日起改用第二航廈 報到與行李提領同步調整
taiwan_aviation.summary: 自2026年10月25日起，華航桃園往返香港航班改由桃園機場第二航廈營運，出發旅客在第二航廈報到及辦理出境，抵達旅客則在第二航廈辦理入境及提領行李。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: China Airlines moves Taoyuan–Hong Kong flights to Terminal 2 from October 25
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: From October 25, 2026, China Airlines flights between Taoyuan and Hong Kong will use Terminal 2 at Taoyuan Airport. Check-in and departure procedures, as well as arrival procedures and baggage claim, will move there too.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 星宇航空9月營收年增69% 客運與貨運營收同步成長
taiwan_aviation.summary: 星宇航空9月營收為新臺幣49.75億元，年增69%；客運營收年增70%，貨運營收年增59%。公司表示貨運旺季需求升溫，並將自10月起開闢新航線，且已與美國航空展開聯營合作。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Starlux September revenue rises 69% as passenger and cargo sales grow
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Starlux reported September revenue of NT$4.975 billion, up 69% year on year. Passenger revenue rose 70% and cargo revenue 59%. The airline cited strengthening peak-season cargo demand, announced new routes from October and said it had begun a joint-operating partnership with American Airlines.

international_aviation.headline: 希斯洛機場稱逾40家航空公司尋求時段 可用容量持續不足
international_aviation.summary: 希斯洛機場表示，超過40家航空公司正尋求取得機場時段，需求持續超過可用容量。機場主張擴建及興建第三條跑道，並稱增加容量可容納新航空公司與航線、提升競爭。
international_aviation.headline_en: Heathrow says more than 40 airlines seek slots as demand exceeds capacity
international_aviation.summary_en: Heathrow says more than 40 airlines are seeking airport slots and demand continues to exceed available capacity. The airport is advocating expansion, including a third runway, and says added capacity could make room for new airlines and routes and increase competition.

international_aviation.headline: 空中巴士U740 Valkyrie完成歐洲首次飛行 並達成測試目標
international_aviation.summary: 空中巴士表示，U740 Valkyrie無人戰鬥機在北歐測試設施完成歐洲首次飛行並達成各項目標。測試包括火箭助推起飛、不同高度的飛行操作及最高Mach 0.8飛行，為搭載MARS任務系統的後續測試鋪路。
international_aviation.headline_en: Airbus U740 Valkyrie completes first European flight and meets test objectives
international_aviation.summary_en: Airbus says the U740 Valkyrie uncrewed combat aircraft completed its first European flight at a Northern European test facility and met all objectives. The test included rocket-assisted takeoff, maneuvers at different altitudes and speeds up to Mach 0.8, paving the way for further testing with the MARS mission system.

international_aviation.headline: Vietjet擴大與Collins Aerospace合作 支援新增44架A320neo系列飛機
international_aviation.summary: Vietjet擴大與Collins Aerospace的合作，透過FlightSense為新增44架GTF動力A320neo系列飛機提供技術及維修支援。RTX表示，修訂後的合約包括零組件可用性保障，並以降低停機時間及提高成本可預測性為目標。
international_aviation.headline_en: Vietjet expands Collins Aerospace partnership to support 44 additional A320neo-family jets
international_aviation.summary_en: Vietjet expanded its partnership with Collins Aerospace to provide technical and maintenance support through FlightSense for 44 additional GTF-powered A320neo-family aircraft. RTX says the amended contract includes guaranteed component availability and is intended to reduce downtime and improve cost predictability.

international_aviation.headline: Aegean任命Michalis Kouveliotis接任執行長 Gerogiannis交接期間續任顧問
international_aviation.summary: Aegean Airlines於2026年10月12日宣布，Michalis Kouveliotis立即接任執行長。他自2025年初起擔任副執行長，曾任財務長逾20年；前執行長Dimitris Gerogiannis將在交接期間擔任顧問並監督技術基地與訓練中心。
international_aviation.headline_en: Aegean appoints Michalis Kouveliotis CEO as Gerogiannis advises during transition
international_aviation.summary_en: Aegean Airlines announced on October 12, 2026, that Michalis Kouveliotis would take over as CEO immediately. He has been Deputy CEO since early 2025 and previously served as CFO for more than 20 years. Dimitris Gerogiannis will advise during the transition and oversee the Technical Base and Training Center.

international_aviation.headline: Cummings Aerospace於8月25日展示單人以一控制器操作兩架Hellhound S3
international_aviation.summary: Cummings Aerospace表示，2026年8月25日在奧勒岡州的測試中，單一操作員以一具手持控制器監控兩架搭載惰性酬載的Hellhound S3；兩機依序發射，各自飛行預先設定的航線。公司稱展示達成所有預定目標。
international_aviation.headline_en: Cummings Aerospace demonstrates one operator controlling two Hellhound S3 drones on August 25
international_aviation.summary_en: Cummings Aerospace said a single operator monitored two Hellhound S3 drones from one handheld controller during a test in Oregon on August 25, 2026. Both carried inert payloads and flew separate pre-programmed routes after sequential launches. The company said the demonstration met all its objectives.

international_aviation.headline: NetJets規劃在美國三座機場興建新航廈 並擴大西棕櫚灘專用設施
international_aviation.summary: NetJets計畫在Dallas Love Field、Washington Dulles及科羅拉多州Rifle Garfield County Airport設置新航廈，其中Dallas設施預定2028年底啟用，Rifle園區預計2027年初營運。在西棕櫚灘，專用航廈面積將由10,000平方英尺增至15,000平方英尺。
international_aviation.headline_en: NetJets plans new terminals at three US airports and a larger facility in West Palm Beach
international_aviation.summary_en: NetJets plans new terminals at Dallas Love Field, Washington Dulles and Rifle Garfield County Airport in Colorado. The Dallas complex is scheduled to open in late 2028, while the Rifle facility is expected to be operational by early 2027. In West Palm Beach, its exclusive-use terminal will expand from 10,000 to 15,000 square feet.
